change_summary: Use the existing sentiment-surface classifier as an experiment-only allocation field and sweep a cap-aware risk multiplier for non-ETF/non-Commodity core signals classified as theme_mania.

mid_weak.state_note: rotation-heavy bull where strategy makes money but lags indexes

old_thin.state_note: mixed-to-weak older tape with lower win rate

field_check.note: This allocation experiment does not depend on these fields.

hypothesis: Core stock signals in the theme_mania sentiment surface may be crowded enough to deserve a risk haircut, or strong enough to deserve a small top-up. A single cap-aware multiplier should improve EV without changing entry filters, ranking, exits, universe, LLM, or news logic.
known_risks: Moderate multiple-testing risk because core market-state and allocation fields have many accepted predecessors.
The sentiment proxy is production-visible but coarse until daily market context is persisted per signal.
Cap-aware multipliers can be immaterial if existing core sizing is already at the default position cap.

market_regime_summary.mid_weak: rotation-heavy bull where strategy makes money but lags indexes
market_regime_summary.old_thin: mixed-to-weak older tape with lower win rate

next_retry_requires: Do not retry adjacent theme_mania sentiment multipliers on the same frozen windows without forward rows or a richer persisted market-context field.
If sentiment remains promising, first persist full daily sentiment context per signal before another sizing test.
notes: No JavaScript used. This is alpha_search, not measurement repair.

parameters.field_definition: theme_mania market-sentiment proxy inferred from replay-visible regime_exit_bucket, strategy, and sector metadata

production_impact.promotion_required_if_accepted: Move sentiment-surface theme_mania state and risk multiplier into shared sentiment_surface/portfolio_engine plumbing with tests, then rerun the same three-window protocol.

rejection_reason: Best variant failed Gate 4 because at least one fixed window regressed in expected_value_score.
sweep_summary: <stripped 137KB oversized field; full value retained in the experiment artifact>
why_not_other_changes: Skipped LLM soft-ranking due sparse attribution, broad-market due identity drift, event/governance/source scalars due recent repeated drawdown/sample failures, state-surface profile/notional retunes due the strict same-family gate, and broad default cap relief because exp-20260522-012 just failed old_thin. Also avoided another core single-name return-path field after exp-20260522-013 and exp-20260522-014. The constructive sentiment branch in exp-20260522-015 had zero adjusted signals, so this tests the nonzero-sample sentiment bucket instead.
